import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { getWeeklyRebateInfoData } from '@src/response-apps/recharge/weeklyRebateInfo/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { createQuoteMarkdown, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;

  const send = (
    title: string,
    md: ReturnType<typeof Format.createMarkdown>,
    options?: {
      footer?: Array<{ label: string; command: string }>;
    }
  ) => {
    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title, content: md, footer: options?.footer }));
  };

  try {
    const result = await getWeeklyRebateInfoData(uid, bid);

    if (result.code === 'NOT_ELIGIBLE') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(`账号需满${result.minAccountDays}天才能参与周周返利（当前${result.daysSinceRegistration}天）`);
      send('', md);

      return;
    }

    if (result.code === 'FAILED') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('查询失败，请稍后再试。');
      send('', md);

      return;
    }

    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(`今日：${result.todayLabel}`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(`今日充值：${result.todayRechargeText}元/${result.thresholdYuan}元`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('【每日奖励】');

    for (const day of result.dayRewards) {
      md.addNewline();

      const title = day.canClaim ? day.label : `${day.label} ${day.statusTag}`;

      md.addBlockquote(createQuoteMarkdown([title, day.rewardText], day.canClaim ? [{ label: '领取', command: `/周周返利领取 ${day.day}` }] : []));
    }

    md.addNewline();

    send('周周返利', md, {
      footer: [{ label: '充值', command: '/充值' }]
    });
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('查询周周返利信息失败:', error);
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('查询失败，请稍后再试。');
    send('', md);
  }
});
